title: Histogram

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 200)
SELECT round(50 + 15 * ((abs(random() % 1000) + abs(random() % 1000) + abs(random() % 1000)) / 1500.0 - 1) * 2.5) AS score
FROM n

show.title: horizontal (default): bins, series { color }
show.description:
Horizontal bars, one per bin, labeled `[from, to)`; `bins: 10` asks for ten bins (the
default follows Sturges' rule); the rule `series { color }` colors them.

show.title: chart { renderer: vertical }, value { display: none }
show.description:
Columns labeled with their lower edge (`:DbDashStyle histogram vertical`);
`value { display: none }` hides the counts.

show.title: bin_width, bin_range
show.description:
`bin_width: 10` makes every bin 10 wide and `bin_range: [0, 100]` fixes where they
start and end (Vega-Lite `bin.step`, `bin.extent`); values outside are left out.

query.sql:

show.title: normalize: percent, cumulative
show.description:
`normalize: percent` shows each bin's share of all values (`density`: per unit of the
value); `cumulative` adds the bins up, so the last one is 100%.

query.sql:

show.title: mark_lines: mean, a limit
show.description:
`mark_lines` are values of the data: the bin each falls in is colored and labeled
(here the mean, and a pass mark of 60 with `class: pass`, colored by `mark.pass`).
